experiments.name: CHOCH retest proximity band
experiments.code_change: 2 sites, +5/-1 lines against the executed baseline
experiments.old_behavior: hitR = isLong ? l <= L : h >= L   (exact level, zero tolerance)
experiments.new_behavior: hitR = isLong ? l <= L + tol : h >= L - tol, tol = 0.10 x ATR(14) on the LTF, obtained via request.security_lower_tf and used ONLY for this proximity test
experiments.assertions: all remain valid and must read 0
experiments.superseded_status: NEVER EXECUTED - derived from the canonical source, retained as history

experiments.name: BOS reference includes the CHOCH pivot
experiments.code_change: 2 hunks, +2/-4 lines against the executed baseline
experiments.old_behavior: most recent confirmed opposing pivot after CHOCH, CHOCH pivot EXCLUDED (falls back to the previous pivot when they coincide)
experiments.new_behavior: most recent confirmed opposing pivot after CHOCH, CHOCH pivot INCLUDED
experiments.assertions: A22 (BOS pivot != CHOCH pivot) is EXPECTED TO BE NON-ZERO for this experiment by construction; it is retained and reported, not disabled. All other assertions must read 0.
experiments.superseded_status: NEVER EXECUTED - derived from the canonical source, retained as history

experiments.name: first qualifying FVG at/after the displacement candle
experiments.code_change: 2 sites, +7/-4 lines against the executed baseline
experiments.old_behavior: exactly one test, at LTF bar d+1: the FVG whose middle candle IS the displacement candle; no gap => setup invalid
experiments.new_behavior: scan forward from d+1, testing at each LTF bar the gap whose middle candle is the previous bar; take the FIRST qualifying gap whose middle candle is at or after the displacement candle
experiments.pre_registered_scan_bound: the existing dispWait = 12 chart-bar deadline measured from the sweep bar. No new parameter is introduced. If the deadline passes with no qualifying gap, the setup is invalid.
experiments.flag: This bound is a mechanical consequence of the rule change, not a second rule: the baseline needs no bound because it tests exactly one bar. Recorded explicitly for the reader's judgement.
experiments.assertions: A24 (BOS bar == displacement bar) is evaluated only on the first scan bar, where it retains its original meaning; it must still read 0. All other assertions must read 0.
experiments.superseded_status: NEVER EXECUTED - derived from the canonical source, retained as history

experiments.name: raw sweep extreme stop
experiments.old_behavior: long = sweep low - 0.20 x ATR(5m); short = sweep high + 0.20 x ATR(5m)
experiments.new_behavior: long = sweep low; short = sweep high (no buffer)
experiments.assertions: all remain valid and must read 0
experiments.superseded_status: NEVER EXECUTED - derived from the canonical source, retained as history

experiments.name: first-eligible CHOCH reference, no roll
experiments.code_change: 6 hunks, +14/-8 lines against the executed baseline
experiments.old_behavior: most recent confirmed eligible opposing pivot, re-evaluated forward on every LTF bar
experiments.new_behavior: the FIRST confirmed eligible opposing pivot after the sweep is latched and retained for the life of the sequence
experiments.assertions: counter 4 changes meaning (it now counts how often a roll WOULD have occurred) and is reported as such; A21/A32 remain valid and must read 0. All other assertions must read 0.
experiments.superseded_status: NEVER EXECUTED - derived from the canonical source, retained as history

provenance_correction.raised: Phase 15, at the start of Experiment C1, after Experiment B completed
provenance_correction.summary: The initial manifest identified V53_ltf_sequence.pine as the execution baseline. An audit during Experiment B preparation established that TradingView had actually been executing the artifact now preserved at p15/executed/V53_EXECUTED_BUILD.pine. The two were compared and found to have identical strategy-bearing logic, differing only in write-only diagnostics and the output layer.

canonical_source.role: canonical frozen V53 source; Phase 13E audited it; NOT the artifact that executed

executed_baseline.role: the actual TradingView artifact that produced all Phase 15 measurements; provenance anchor for the whole phase
executed_baseline.capture_integrity: reported 602 lines / 27,240 chars; captured file is 602 lines / 27,241 bytes (difference is the trailing newline)

equivalence_verification.method: strategy sections 1-6 of both files extracted (everything before the line 'g(i) => str.tostring(array.get(K, i))'), comments and blank lines stripped, then diffed
differences_found: writes to K33 and K34 in the section 6 detector-verification block
writes to K35 in the same block
the `tie` boolean local and the loop that sets it, which exists only to gate K35
equivalence_verification.difference_classification: write-only diagnostics. K33, K34, K35 and `tie` are never read by any decision in the program; the canonical build only displays them as table rows D33/D34/D35. They cannot affect strategy behaviour.
also_identical: all 15 inputs, in the same order, so the in_0..in_14 mapping is preserved
SP, RB, and the fold boundaries FB/FC/FE
equivalence_verification.other_differences: comments, and the section 7 output layer (table structure and ledger header)

provenance_correction.A_B_provenance: Experiments A and B were generated by the executed V53 artifact (p15/executed/V53_EXECUTED_BUILD.pine), not directly by V53_ltf_sequence.pine.
provenance_correction.A_B_validity: Experiments A and B remain valid because the executed artifact's strategy-bearing logic is identical to the canonical V53, and the intended experimental input was the only strategy-bearing change between arms. They are NOT rerun and their recorded results are preserved unchanged.
provenance_correction.C_to_G_provenance: Experiments C1-G1 are generated from the actual executed baseline artifact, with exactly one predefined strategy-bearing modification per arm. The executed build's diagnostic and output layers are carried through byte-identical.

superseded_artifacts.reason: derived from the canonical source rather than the executed artifact; retained as historical evidence, not deleted
